title: SchematronPackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly schematron (INV-REQ-471, INV-REQ-482): the Schematron files of the target PINT-SG version's resources.zip, held byte for byte, each with its SHA-256 and its content as base64. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by rules-svc at import, at the pack dry run and by the seed content test, not here: the sha256 of each file equals the SHA-256 of its decoded content; a name appears once. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

version.description: The target PINT-SG version label of the Schematron files.

files.description: The Schematron files of the target version, byte for byte.

name.description: The file name, with no path.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the decoded content, 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
